title: Preferential binding of human BRCA1 protein with open X-like conformation of Holliday junction, a homologous recombination intermediate
authors: Sahil Hasan Kabir; Vishnupriya K; Nibedita Pal
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单分子FCS、分子对接和全原子MD研究BRCA1蛋白与Holliday junction（同源重组中间体）的偏好性结合模式，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且采用物理模拟方法，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但方法可迁移至转录因子-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BRCA1 is a complex tumor suppressor protein involved in multiple critical cellular processes, e.g., DNA double strand break repair, cell cycle checkpoint, etc. BRCA1 depleted cells are reported to have decreased homologous recombination (HR) and promote error-prone non-homologous end joining for DNA damage repair. Holliday junction (HJ) is an important intermediate of HR. Although BRCA1 is shown to have a very high affinity for HJ and recruits several proteins at the DNA damage site, the question remains what the binding mode of BRCA1 protein with an HJ is. Using single-molecule Fluorescence Correlation Spectroscopy (FCS) we have shown that BRCA1 prefers an open X-like conformation of HJ and has a lesser affinity for stacked HJ. Further, using molecular docking and all-atom molecular dynamics simulation, we show that mostly charged and polar amino acids in the DNA binding region of BRCA1 form complex with HJ. Interestingly, most of those amino acids are reported to be places for missense changes.
abstract_zh: BRCA1是一种复杂的肿瘤抑制蛋白，参与多种关键细胞过程，例如DNA双链断裂修复、细胞周期检查点等。据报道，BRCA1耗竭细胞具有降低的同源重组（HR）能力，并促进易错的非同源末端连接以进行DNA损伤修复。Holliday连接（HJ）是HR的重要中间体。尽管已显示BRCA1对HJ具有非常高的亲和力，并在DNA损伤位点招募多种蛋白质，但BRCA1蛋白与HJ的结合模式仍是一个未解问题。利用单分子荧光相关光谱（FCS），我们已显示BRCA1偏好开放的X形HJ构象，对堆叠HJ的亲和力较低。此外，通过分子对接和全原子分子动力学模拟，我们表明BRCA1 DNA结合区域中主要是带电和极性氨基酸与HJ形成复合物。有趣的是，这些氨基酸中的大多数据报道是错义突变的位置。
